risk_summary: The disclosure presents severe liquidity and going-concern risk: the company has no positive operating cash flow, expects continuing losses, had only $2.5 million in cash against $14.7 million of annual operating cash use, and stated funding was sufficient only through June 2019. Continued operations depend on raising substantial additional capital or securing strategic alliances, with potential abandonment of development and commercialization efforts if funding is unavailable.
